remarks: Absolutely stunning, one of a kind 1 bedroom loft! - Features a totally renovated kitchen with white shaker cabinetry, quartz counters, subway tile backsplash, stainless appliances and natural wood island - Amazing reclaimed wood beams & custom shiplap feature walls throughout!! - Updated bathroom with luxurious oversized walk-in shower with glass door - Large walk-in closet - Great lofted bedroom with custom stairs and cable railings - Vaulted ceiling highlights the light and bright living room space - Separate laundry room with private washer / dryer in unit - Second loft space makes for a great storage room - LED lighting & vinyl wood-look flooring throughout - Ductless wall-unit AC - Off-street parking for 1 car - Tenant pays $175 / month flat fee on top of rent for all utilities! (tenant pays for cable / internet separately) - 1 cat or small dog considered on case by case basis
